Track your own before/after time on two or three real tasks instead of guessing.

items.text: The professional stack replaces roughly ৳40,000-80,000/mo in outsourced content creation costs — a content writer, a junior designer, and a video editor. The ROI is immediate for any business already spending on content.

items.text: Simple automations (WhatsApp auto-reply, invoice generation): ৳5,000-15,000 one-time. Medium complexity (multi-step workflow with conditional logic): ৳15,000-50,000. Complex (custom integrations, API work): ৳50,000-200,000+. Bangladeshi rates are 40-60% lower than US/UK agencies, which is your competitive advantage on Fiverr and Upwork.

items.text: Example: a Dhaka clothing retailer spends 3 hours daily answering the same WhatsApp questions. You build an automation: customer messages → AI reads and categorises → auto-responds with correct answer → forwards complex queries to the owner. Setup fee: ৳10,000. Monthly maintenance: ৳2,000. Client saves 60+ hours/month. You earn ৳10,000 upfront plus ৳24,000/year recurring.

items.text: Multiply this by 10 clients and you have a ৳20,000/month recurring business with ৳100,000 in upfront project fees. This is not hypothetical — it's what the first wave of Bangladeshi automation agency owners are doing right now.

items.text: Beginner (first 5 clients): ৳5,000-10,000 per automation. You're building a portfolio. Focus on delivering value and getting testimonials, not maximising price.

items.text: Intermediate (5-20 clients, portfolio built): ৳15,000-50,000 per project. You have case studies, testimonials, and a clear process. Charge based on value delivered, not hours worked.

items.reason: earnings/savings/cost figure (class D): editorial fact-check pending; not an AITP price
items.text: Advanced (20+ clients, recurring revenue): ৳50,000-200,000+ for complex systems. Add monthly maintenance retainers (৳3,000-10,000/month per client). At 10 retainer clients at ৳5,000/month, you have ৳50,000/month before taking any new project work.

items.text: AI Marketing Assistant (৳20,000-45,000/month): run digital marketing campaigns using AI for content, analytics, and optimisation. The role combines traditional marketing knowledge with AI tool proficiency.

items.text: AI Automation Specialist (৳30,000-80,000/month): build automated workflows for businesses using no-code tools. The highest-paying entry-level AI role and the one with the clearest freelance path.

items.text: AI-Enabled Virtual Assistant (৳15,000-40,000/month freelance): provide VA services to international clients using AI to multiply your output. Bangladeshi VAs who use AI are winning higher-paying clients than those who don't.

Top performers doing specialised work (automation, professional design, high-end content): ৳50,000-150,000/month. These are real ranges from actual Bangladeshi freelancers, not aspirational estimates.

items.text: 1. AI content writing for blogs and businesses (৳500-2,000/article): many Bangladeshi businesses need English content but don't have writers. You use ChatGPT to draft, then edit for accuracy and voice. One 1,000-word article takes ~1 hour with AI assistance. 2 articles/day = ৳2,000-4,000/day.

items.text: 3. AI-assisted graphic design on Fiverr (৳1,000-5,000/project): use Midjourney or Ideogram for concept generation, Canva for final designs. Logo design, social media graphics, book covers. Start at low prices, build reviews, raise rates.

items.text: 4. Virtual assistant with AI efficiency (৳15,000-40,000/month): international clients hire Bangladeshi VAs for admin, research, and customer support. Use AI to do the work of 2-3 people — clients pay for output, not hours.

items.reason: earnings/savings/cost figure (class D): editorial fact-check pending; not an AITP price
items.text: 5. YouTube automation with AI (variable, ৳0-50,000+/month after 3-6 months): use AI for script writing, voiceover (ElevenLabs), and video creation. Faceless channels in niches like tech reviews, history, or educational content. Slow start, compounding returns.

items.text: 6. Online tutoring with AI support (৳300-800/hour): teach English, math, or coding to students in Bangladesh or abroad. Use AI to prepare lesson plans, create practice problems, and grade assignments. Your human teaching + AI efficiency = competitive advantage.

items.text: 7. AI automation services for local businesses (৳5,000-30,000/project): find a business doing something manually → automate it → charge for the setup. The most scalable option because each automation is a product you can sell to multiple businesses.

items.text: Don't compete on price — compete on AI-enabled speed and quality. A ৳2,000 article that takes you 30 minutes with AI is better business than a ৳500 article that takes you 2 hours without AI. Your competitive advantage is that AI makes you faster, not cheaper.
